senses.gloss: f. (נְגַד, נְגַר) dragging out of the grave by necromancy.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 56b:18">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>אסקיה לטיטוס בנ׳</he> (Ar. ed. Koh. … <he>רה</he>; oth. ed. Ar. … <he>רא</he>) he had Titus brought up out of his grave; ib. 57ᵃ top <he>אסקיה לישו בנ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>לפושע ישראל</he>).
<cite ref="Shabbat 152b:13">Sabb. 152ᵇ</cite> <he>אובא טמיא … בנ׳</he> how could the necromancer have brought Samuel up (if his soul was not in the grave)?
